answer: Wasserstein mirror screening of graders: each epoch, compute every juror's distribution of score residuals versus panel consensus. Pairs whose residual distributions stay within a tiny earth-mover distance across many unrelated panels form a statistical mirror, since independent judges drift apart over an ocean of different answers while one controller's clones stay aligned. Co-flagged pairs chain into a vine; each connected vine shares one grader weight until a beacon-drawn panel that splits them shows their residuals diverge. Honest graders lose nothing.
